bodyHtml:
Education

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, National Chiao-Tung University, Taiwan (2008)
  • M.S. in Computer Science, National Chiao-Tung University, Taiwan (2004)
  • B.A. in Computer and Information Science, National Chiao-Tung University, Taiwan (2002)

Experience

  • Associate Professor, Graduate Institute of Journalism, National Taiwan University (2017.08 – present)
  • Associate Professor, Graduate Institute of Library and Information Science, National Taiwan Normal University (2016.02 – 2016.07)
  • Assistant Professor, Graduate Institute of Library and Information Science, National Taiwan Normal University (2010.02 – 2016.01)
  • Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science, University of Taipei (2009.08 – 2010.01)

Journals

  • Chong, J., & Hsieh, J.-L. (2026). Investigating AI’s Agency through Anthropomorphic Metaphors in News: An Exploratory Study of ETtoday. Mass Communication Research, 166, 93–142. Full text
  • Hsieh, J.-L. (2026). Examining Research Designs for LLM-Based Automated Text Annotation: An Empirical Analysis Centered on Task Interpretive Demands. Journal of Library & Information Science Research, 20(2), 119. Article record
  • Huang, J.-R., Chao, S.-F., Hsieh, J.-L., & Shao, H.-L. (2026). Mapping heterogeneity in retirement transition pathways: Integrating qualitative longitudinal and text mining analysis. Innovation in Aging, igag096. https://doi.org/10.1093/geroni/igag096
  • J. L., Hsieh. (2017). Author publication preferences and journal competition. Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology, 68: 365-377. (SSCI)
  • J.L. Hsieh, P.C. Shen, L.W. Yang. (2015). Designing and Evaluating User Interface for Assisting News Navigation and Retrieval. Journal of Library and Information Science Research, 9(2), 149-189. (TSSCI)
  • Y.L. Wen, J.L. Hsieh. (2014). Informetric Analysis on Open-Access High Productivity Authors in Biomedical Area. Journal of Educational Media & Library Sciences, 51(2), 199-224. (TSSCI)

Conference

  • J. L., Hsieh & C. Y., Yu. (2017). Speed as context of app usage in daily life: A data analysis method. 2017 Pacific Neighborhood Consortium Annual Conference and Joint Meetings (PNC), Tainan, Taiwan.
  • J. L., Hsieh & L. C., Chiu. (2014). Structural and trend analysis of tagging as a mechanism for organizing learning resources. International Conference on Computers in Education.
  • J. L., Hsieh & C. Y., Yu. (2014). An analysis on the rhythm of social media use. In Proceedings of 4th International Symposium on Pervasive Computing Paradigms for Mental Health. Tokyo, Japan.

Invited Speeches

  • Workshop on conducting eye-tracking by portable eye-trackers and open software. Centre for Information Technology in Education, Faculty of Education, The University of Hong Kong. (2016.11.09)
  • Play to learn: How mobile games can be good for our kids? CITE Research Symposium 2016 "Engaging Learners: Games and Flipped Learning". The University of Hong Kong. (2016.06.04)

Honors and Awards

  • Overall Best Paper Award — "Structural and trend analysis of tagging as a mechanism for organizing learning resources" (2014). 22nd International Conference on Computers in Education, Japan: Asia-Pacific Society for Computers in Education.

Professional Services

  • Secretary General Chinese Communication Society (2016.08–2018.07)

Research Interests

  • Online Community Analysis
  • Quantified-Self and Lifelogging
  • Eye-Tracking
  • Social Network Analysis
  • Digital Game and Society
  • Social Simulation

External Links

  • C.C. Lab
expertise: Data Analysis in Journalism; Web Design for Storytelling; Social Media and Public Opinion Analysis; Journalism Processing and Visualization; Augmented / Virtual Reality Applications on Journalism
